tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Condenser tubes
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms & conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder/vendor i.e. Qualified Equipment Manufacturer(QEM) should have Successfully manufactured and supplied tubes(as per ASTM A269/ASME SA269 or ASTM A249/ASME SA249) For Condenser application of Outer Diameter 50mm or below, Thickness 1.2446mm (18 BWG) or below and length 12 meters or above of valve not less than Rs.44.76 lakh in single order to any thermal power station of capacity not less than 500MW during the preceding 5 financial years (2020-21,2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25). As a proof, bidder shall upload relevant PO/JO/WO copies and respective performance certificate as per Annexure -1 for successful operation of tubes in plant condenser for minimum one year.(PO/JO/WO of previous years shall be given weightage of 10 percent per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have minimum following in-house manufacturing/testing facilities Online Tube manufacturing mill(s) having processes like forming. Welding Heat Treatment (Bright Annealing), Eddy current testing, cutting etc. as an automatic continuous process. without any manual intervention. In support of this, Bidder/Vendor (Qualified Equipment manufacturer) to submit signed and stamped Annexure 2

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relavant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved average annual financial turnover of Rs. 89.53 lakhs, in at least two financial years during last five years (2020-21,2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25). As a proof, bidder shall upload certified copy of profit & loss account or Turnover certificate certified by Chartered Accountant. (Financial) Turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited).

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Duly filled specification schedule mentioning make, model, delivery period, GST, HSN code clearly
